snippet.title: "MISTROGUE: Mist and the Living Dungeons" EA version Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
"MISTROGUE: Mist and the Living Dungeons" is a new type of strategic roguelike action game characterized by the "living dungeons" where the structure dynamically changes in front of your eyes. You fight through them using vital equipment and skills, and the "Maze Stone", which enables you to modify dungeon's structure.

Steam Store Page：
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2102320/MISTROGUE/
